description: Job-description sentences → expected fair-hiring JD rail verdict (warnings are shown on the editable job card).

cases.text: We want a young, dynamic team of digital natives.
Male candidates preferred for this field role.
Applicants must be under 30 years old.
Ideal candidate is a recent graduates only hire.
Must not have any health issues.
Please attach a photo; we prefer good-looking sales reps.
Unmarried candidates only, as the role needs frequent travel.
5+ years of professional frontend experience with React and TypeScript.
We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants regardless of age, gender, religion or disability.
Must have the right to work in Bangladesh; we do not offer visa sponsorship.
Generous parental leave and flexible hours.
Hybrid (3 days in office) in Dhaka.
Experience mentoring engineers and raising the bar on code review.
